title: No-regret optimization of time-varying bilevel problems
summary: Bilevel optimization problems arise in many applications where decisions must account for the optimal response of another system, such as in game-theoretic settings. However, these problems are notoriously challenging, as even linear bilevel programs are strongly NP-hard. In this work, we consider bilevel optimization with a known upper-level objective and an unknown, potentially time-varying lower-level response, accessible only through noisy zeroth-order observations.
